answer: A vouch counts only when the vouching agent has bonded history staked, so a thousand fresh keys weigh as one. Endorsements also need a countersignature from a rotating quorum across regions, so faking breadth means persuading established agents to lock real value, which a proven cluster forfeits. Standing climbs like a vine, not a fan, and that ferrous anchor of burned stake, sunk through the whole ocean of endorsements, keeps honesty cheap.
